app.title: Outage Tracker
app.description: Track power (ENEO) and water (Camwater) outages in your quartier

report.heading: Report an outage
report.rateLimitNote: One report per quartier every 30 min
report.describeIntro: Or describe the outage in your own words (English, French or Pidgin)
report.describePlaceholder: e.g. We no get light for Bonamoussadi since morning

login.heading: Sign in
login.note: We verify by SMS. Your number is never shown publicly.

about.heading: How it works
about.intro: Outage Tracker is a citizen-run, real-time view of power (ENEO) and water (Camwater) outages, neighborhood by neighborhood. Anyone can report in under 10 seconds and neighbors confirm to build trust.
howSteps: Out: 3 or more reports from different users within 30 minutes.
Unconfirmed: 1–2 recent reports, not yet enough.
Restored: 2 "back on" reports, or 1 with a confirmation.
Unknown: no new reports for 6 hours — status expires.
about.credibilityBody: Every report can be confirmed by neighbors with one tap ("Me too"). The more independent confirmations, the more trustworthy the status. Abuse is limited: one report per user per quartier every 30 minutes, verified accounts only.
about.privacyBody: Your phone number is verified once and never shown publicly. If you use the AI assistant, only your message text is sent for parsing — never your identity.
about.disclaimerBody: This platform is citizen-sourced, not official. For authoritative information contact ENEO or Camwater directly.

admin.heading: Admin
admin.lockedBody: Sign in with an admin account to moderate reports and manage quartiers.
